Earlier reports revealed that WhatsApp was developing a brand-new conversation theme feature, and this functionality has now been officially rolled out to iPhone users. Here's a detailed overview.

WhatsApp's new conversation themes include dynamic backgrounds

According to WABetaInfo, WhatsApp is currently launching conversation themes across five major categories: Featured, Nature, Dynamic, Minimal, and Doodle. Just two weeks ago, the website had discovered clues about the new theme series from the code.

The website pointed out that the "Featured" category includes "the best themes carefully selected by the WhatsApp design team"; the "Nature" category "brings outdoor scenery into the conversation screen"; the "Dynamic" category offers "wallpapers that move slowly in the background"; the "Minimal" theme "applies a solid colour background to the conversation screen: white in light mode, black in dark mode"; as for "Doodle", it includes WhatsApp's classic wallpapers with doodle patterns.

The following is WABetaInfo's introduction to the "Dynamic" wallpapers, arguably the most noteworthy feature this time:

WABetaInfo stated that WhatsApp will automatically match conversation bubble colours based on the selected theme, and added that, as is customary with WhatsApp, the new feature may not be available to all users immediately.
